title: Project Banner
lede: Used for temporary, project-wide notifications that require resolution

examples.heading: Default

children.text: Attack Challenge Mode is enabled for this project

examples.heading: Success
examples.description: For positive, temporary mitigations put in place to protect a project, e.g., Attack Challenge Mode

children.text: Attack Challenge Mode is enabled for this project

examples.heading: Warning
examples.description: When a project is in an exceptional state which requires non-immediate action to exit, e.g., during a rollback

children.text: This project was rolled back by

examples.heading: Error
examples.description: When a project is approaching or experiencing critical downtime which requires immediate attention, e.g., when payment is overdue

children.text: Payment failed, update credit card information before your account is shut down
